author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the announcement trailer for XENOFLEKT, a roguelite space shooter developed by 
Catoio Software. Players will turn enemy bullets into armory: dash into enemy fire to parry and deflect shots, heal your ship, and trigger devastating counter-attacks. Unlock parts, plug in unique perks with satellites, and get ready to master hundreds of deadly synergies. XENOFLEKT is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: XENOFLEKT - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the release window trailer for Castle in the Sands, an atmospheric visual novel developed by Winter Apple. You are a young hunter who lives with his family in a little village deep in the desert. Soon, you find yourself in a big ancient castle located in the middle of the Sahara — a beautiful, but fragile place. Its walls seem to crumble at your touch. And only your decisions can save it from the danger of human ambition and greed. Set in a world inspired by "One Thousand and One Nights" and Eastern culture, Castle in the Sands is launching in May on PC (Steam).
title: Castle in the Sands - Official Release Window Trailer
